speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and how long you have been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given your work with livestock and rice farming, have you noticed any exposure to animals like cats or rodents, or have you experienced any recent weight loss or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those specific findings, particularly the eyebrow thinning and hypopigmented macules, strongly suggest a systemic issue. Have you experienced any difficulty swallowing or changes in your skin texture, such as it becoming thick and tight?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow thinning, and sensory changes in the palms is highly characteristic of Hansen's disease. I would like to confirm if you have noticed any thickening of your peripheral nerves or weakness in your hands. REQUEST TEST: Slit-Skin_Smear

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal slit-skin smear does not rule out leprosy, particularly the tuberculoid form which often has few or no bacilli. Let me examine your peripheral nerves directly to check for thickening or tendness, and I will also perform a skin biopsy of one of the hypopigmented macules for histopathology. REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy
